why: No app has ever gone through the install path a consumer takes. The playground, which judged every cycle, runs on `basaltViteConfig` (the 2.x preset, still exported and documented), has no `.basalt/manifest.json`, 14 hand-written `@source` lines, four hand CSS aliases and a hand copy of the theme script; so the peer gate, the seed gate, the eject alias and the sources file of `basalt()` run only in a test harness. pack-test never calls `init`. Eject is about 1,700 lines no app has run. apps/marketing's manifest still says 2.29.0 and lists managed names that no longer ship. Evidence: docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/freeze.md (section 3, row 4), docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/playground.md (WI-1), docs/v3/STOCKTAKE.md section 3. Trial 2 (docs/v3/evidence/readiness-2026-11-24/trial-2.md, entry 5) hit it the same day: `doctor` 12 of 12, then the first build failed because `basalt-ui/shell` needs `@tanstack/react-hotkeys` and pulls `@atlaskit/pragmatic-drag-and-drop` through the sortable list, and `init` installs neither.
what: The playground is a real `init --profile app` install on `basalt()`, the 2.x preset is deleted, and CI takes the tarball through init, build and render for both profiles.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/vite/index.ts (the `basaltViteConfig` export), src/vite.ts, llms.txt lines on the preset
packages/basalt-ui/scripts/pack-test.sh and the CI job that runs it; apps/marketing/.basalt/manifest.json
must_not_touch: src/cli beyond a defect this row uncovers and cannot work around (then fix it in its own commit and say so)
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/ga/README.md, then the evidence file named in why (every finding there has path:line). Decided: (1) Run `basalt-ui init --profile app` in apps/playground and commit what it writes; the Vite config uses `basalt()`; hand-written `@source` lines, aliases and the theme-script copy go; regenerate accents.css. The workspace keeps resolving the package for dev through a custom export condition or the existing src alias, whichever `basalt()` supports without a special case in shipped code; check first that `basalt()` builds its graph correctly under it. (2) Delete `basaltViteConfig` and src/vite.ts with their docs. (3) pack-test gains two consumers created from the tarball in an empty directory: `init --profile app` then build then a server render of the start page, and `init --profile site` then `astro build` asserting no module script on a static page and one hydrated island. (4) The app consumer ejects one primitive, edits it, builds, and runs `doctor`; every defect found is fixed or filed. (5) apps/marketing is re-synced so its manifest matches what ships. What the code decides: the dev-resolution mechanism in (1). (6) `init --profile app` installs every peer the entries it wires import statically, and `doctor`'s peer check fails when one is missing; the shell loads the drag-and-drop peer only when a sortable part is rendered, or the peer is in the app set, whichever keeps the app profile smaller.
acceptance: apps/playground has a manifest, `basalt-ui doctor` passes in it, and `basalt-ui lint` runs on it in `make check`
`rg basaltViteConfig` finds nothing outside migrations and MIGRATING.md
CI runs both tarball consumers on every head; a seeded break (a missing template file in the tarball) turns the step red
The eject round trip is in the pack-test
A fresh `init --profile app` builds with no further install (the tarball consumer proves it)
make check passes; the layout suite and the quality matrix pass unchanged
out_of_scope: Curating playground pages. New CLI features.
proof: The CI run with both consumers, and the list of defects the first real install found.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, header at most 80 characters, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export, prop, rule id or CLI flag gets its row in migrations/areas and MIGRATING.md and regenerates the docs in the same PR.
